author: Brandons209
description: Allow nitro boosters to add an emoji to the server and custom reactions with channel logging.
install_msg: Thank you for using this cog! Please make sure to set the log channel using `[p]nitroset`
short: Allow boosters to have a server emoji and custom reaction.
end_user_data_statement: This cog will store a user's custom emojis in each guild.
